mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline in the prior month fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate earnings declines and trigger negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in the federal funds rate and rising unemployment rate signals an economic slowdown with accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE rise fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 above 1.0% annualized) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth above 1.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate activity.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100 fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.0%) typically triggers central bank tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 3.0% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and INDPRO fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year window.
